About PakToolkit

What PakToolkit is

PakToolkit is a free online tools website made for Pakistan, live at paktoolkit.top. It brings together two kinds of tools: Pakistan-specific calculators that global websites simply do not offer — a bijli (electricity) bill calculator using the notified tariff, a salary tax calculator for 2025-26, an MDCAT aggregate calculator, a zakat calculator using the government-notified nisab, and a Marla/Kanal land converter — and universal image and PDF tools (compress to KB, passport-size photo maker, image converter, merge/split PDF, JPG to PDF) that everyone needs.

How it works

Every tool runs 100% inside your browser. There is no server processing your files, no upload, no account and no sign-up. When you compress a photo or merge a PDF on PakToolkit, the work happens on your own phone or computer and your file never travels anywhere.

Who runs it

PakToolkit is an independent Pakistani project, run by the same maker behind mrjobs.top, a free job board for Pakistan. Tool ideas and corrections from visitors directly shape what gets built next — send yours through the Contact page.

PakToolkit — free online tools for Pakistan. Every tool runs in your browser; your files never leave your device.
